scope: Unconditional static approval of the exact frozen private v4 profiling harness. No runtime result, performance improvement, restored element-orientation equivalence, physical solve, build, installation or engineering acceptance is claimed by this review.

B882Profile.py.review_method: Complete frozen v3 module read and complete v3-to-v4 two-line hash-buffer delta read; no other source differences.

run_export_profile_v2.py.review_method: Complete prior driver reads and all intervening v3 and v4 diffs; v4 adds defining baseline artifact capture, descriptor equality and mandatory eight-artifact end fencing.

static_assessments.whole_call: The harness invokes the public FemToolsCcx.write_inp_file once, increments its actual harness-call counter immediately before that call, and requires the resulting counter to equal one. Setup/model restore are outside the timed region. Profiling includes instrumentation overhead; it does not replace private phases.
static_assessments.original_and_restored_mesh_scope: The exact historical before-export FCStd, original evidence files and separately observed restored connectivity are hash-pinned before and after. Restored coordinates must equal the original snapshot and actual restored element-ID connectivity must equal the pinned observation. The harness does not rewrite element IDs or node ordering, nor claim that an unordered node set establishes orientation equivalence.
static_assessments.new_baseline_not_inherited_qualification: Historical deck/request/PORT differences are diagnostic only and may differ from this restored export. Old physical qualification is explicitly not inherited. A later candidate must match this new baseline's actual deck except the single declared written-on timestamp comment, exact request and exact PORT IDs. Fresh full132 physical, cold and refusal qualification remain separately required.
static_assessments.nonmutation: Only operational export WorkingDir is routed to a new private directory. Selected physical properties use comparison-only own-document normalization against saved properties, followed by unnormalized in-session before/after hashes. Full physical mesh nodes, volume connectivity and raw group ID/name/type/member/enumeration order are included in before/after hash checks. No solver, mesher, save, recompute, deck edit, model edit or provenance repair is called directly by the harness.
static_assessments.new_graph_policy: The actual emitted request is counted against the complete 264PORT/264BODY/792ANGLE/792SPRING/one-support declaration graph. Captured stock request metadata must bind emitted deck/request hashes, required/total2113, supported budget/limits2113 and the default literal-app native6c binary path/hash. This is export-policy/graph evidence, not a native child solve or physical equilibrium proof.
static_assessments.eight_artifact_custody: Identity JSON, profile JSON and log are captured once and parsed from those same bytes; captured log hash must match the bounded-process receipt. Profiler binary/text plus native Mesh.inp, Mesh.accounting and Mesh.accounting.json are captured with literal path/hash/byte descriptors. The three defining native baseline descriptors must exactly match the profile receipt. All eight artifacts must remain hash/size-identical at final supervisor fencing for PASS.
static_assessments.CPU_and_cumulative_limits: time.process_time covers only this FreeCAD process and profiling overhead, excluding native-child CPU; it is not the cProfile timer. Cumulative times overlap and are not additive phase partitions. Historical unprofiled export time is not paired with profiled wall time; no timing SLA or speedup is established.
static_assessments.process_identity_and_profiles: Source HEAD6ba8 remains separate from actual installed766/+224/native6c. The literal-app identity, bounded2400-second diagnostic run, DEVNULL stdin, serial native guards, owned process-group cleanup, six fresh profile paths, current app/three live user profiles/sixteen dependency custody and private raw inventories are retained.
static_assessments.engineering_limits: Generic software QA only; no Oomakhi access or solve, no engineering/BIM acceptance, no relaxation of the existing1percent/5percent physical limits or engineering failure holds, and no bead-completion claim.

resolved_findings.resolution: The driver captures the three defining graph files, compares descriptors to the exact profile receipt and requires all eight produced artifacts to pass final hash/size fencing.
The profile receipt hashes new_deck and new_request buffers used for comparison and request parsing, not separate filesystem rereads. Metadata already hashes its exact captured metadata_bytes buffer.
